chapter: Father and the brass band tradition
title: Following his father's brass band as a boy
summary: As a boy he followed parades; his father played with the Waifs' Home band and later the Onward, Olympia and Imperial brass bands, on cornet, alto and mellophone.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you tell us anything about the very earliest music you heard when you were a boy? What the bands were like? Were they the brass bands that your father played in or any dance bands? What can you remember when you were just a little kid?

Well, when I knew about music, I got to follow these parades. My dad used to play with Lil Armstrong. Lil Armstrong had to come out to Waves Home then, see. And sometimes the Waves Home band would play in these big parades, you understand what I mean? And Lil's was with the band, see. And after Lil's got out of the home, then he joined my daddy and them, see. I believe it was the Arnold Brass Band, the Olympia Brass Band they had at that time, Imperial Brass Band.
Do you remember much about your father when you were young? Did he practice at home very much? Oh, yeah, my dad always practiced.
He was always practicing? Always practiced. I have my dad's home here now. The alto. I had the melaphone.
I have it here on the alto.
I'd like to see that before we leave. I really want to know.
What kind it is and everything. Did he ever play anything else around the home, a cornet or barricade?

No, his instrument was first instrument, it was cornet. That's what I thought he started. His first instrument was cornet, then he had alto, brass alto, then the melaphone. That's his last instrument.
